_doc: Interior prop library (docs/gdd/04g_interiores.md 4.6.5.1), exported from the "prop" field of assets/inventario.json by tools/interiors/props_catalog.py: do not edit by hand. Per id: category; footprint [cols, rows] in tiles (its long axis rises to the right on screen; mirror = it may be flipped for the other diagonal); size [w, h] of its sprite and feet [x, y], the anchor inside it (where it stands); height = px above the feet (draw order, what it hides); walkable (flat: people walk over it), wall (stands against a wall), on_top (may go on a table or a counter), hangs (hangs on a wall); trades and style, for the builder's rules. The sprite is assets/art/props/interior/<id>.png (game/visuals/visual_paths.gd).
